name: charcoal-tooth
notes: Tileable paper-tooth height field for the charcoal brushes: the texture channel's subtract mode makes stroke alpha a press-depth against this field (docs/fractal-texture-math.md contact model). Rank-equalized so coverage tracks accumulated alpha one-to-one; the pressure response curve therefore lives entirely in the brush documents' flow mapping, and this file only sets the tooth's spatial character. Canvas-anchored and 1024px square, so overlapping strokes share their grain and the tile repeat sits at canvas scale.
